findings.title: Q3 gate-evidence citability remains internally contradictory at the fixed commit
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-STA-002
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

The submitted fix commit a6bddfe82224c6b952257ea4a321abb6ff6879d7 is not an ancestor of 27dd4bd297ac4019928bb9334584643928d7b6d2; this fixed snapshot retains the pre-fix RESULTS_INDEX.md and group-[43] implementation.

RESULTS_INDEX.md:38-44 asserts current STATUS: CITABLE and restores Q3 as admissible Q0 condition-3 evidence, while lines 59-60 say the row stays NOT CITABLE and lines 70-73 repeat Status stays NOT CITABLE. Neither latter assertion is marked HISTORICAL, SUPERSEDED, or RETRACTED.
Q0_NEB_GATE.md:6-12 continues to mark condition 3 PASS; the current index and index-named Q3 authority banners therefore do not assert one status for the same gate evidence.

reproduce: if git merge-base --is-ancestor a6bddfe82224c6b952257ea4a321abb6ff6879d7 HEAD; then exit 1; else echo submitted-fix-not-ancestor; fi; nl -ba RESULTS_INDEX.md | sed -n '38,44p;59,60p;70,73p'; nl -ba results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md | sed -n '6,12p'

A fixture retaining this snapshot's lines 38-44 and 59-60 must fail.

findings.title: Q3 one-state regression masks the current contradictory state at the fixed commit
evidence: cite: §10 / R-GRD-001
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

scripts/20_test_checks.py:1188-1195 sets _q3_banned to a NOT-CITABLE match AND not _q3_citable. The current Q3 block contains both predicates, so the implementation assigns citable=True, not_citable=True, banned=False and does not fail the advertised one-state assertion.

An isolated detached-copy run of python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py exited 0 and printed ALL TESTS PASSED; group [43] reported the contradiction check OK despite the live mixed state established in F-019.
reproduce: python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py && sed -n '1182,1202p' scripts/20_test_checks.py && sed -n '38,73p' RESULTS_INDEX.md
